senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Netsar, one of the alleged disciples of Jesus of Nazareth.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:24">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. a. ed. Ven. (omitted in later edit., v. <cite ref="B00284"><he>בּוּנִי</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: בֶּן נ׳ Ben-Netsar (son of Nassor) name of a chief of robbers who became founder of a dynasty, i.e. Odenathus of Palmyra (v. Cyclop. Brit. s. v. Palmyra, Ersch u. Gruber II, Vol. 27, p. 185, Fürst Gloss., p. 145).
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 51b:19">Keth. 51ᵇ</cite> (opp. to <he>מלכות אחשורוש</he> the legitimate Persian dynasty).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76:6">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>; Yalk. Dan. 1064 <he>בן נָצוֹר</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:4:13">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בר ניצור</he>.
